question: In a certain code language, 'NAMED' is written as 'MBLFC'. How will 'RAZOR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'NAMED' is written as 'MBLFC',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a21d66c00237a910ffd55afbad67f2f16fa529def5b61f50eec57887db518b7c.png] 

Similarly, for '**RAZOR**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b47cf1eff510834991d5cf25e7efdf91e1a76ca70b24ab20f870b8f2f5d8f841.png] 

So, '**RAZOR**' is coded as '**QBYPQ**'.
